description: Department of Labour - Special Allowance payable to workers in the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pappers Growing and Manufacturing Trade
categorisation: This gazette notification announces a special allowance payable to workers in specific agricultural trades (cocoa, cardamom, and pepper), which falls under public sector service conditions and benefits. It deals with wage regulations and worker compensation administered through the Department of Labour, making it a Public Service Gazette rather than a government structure/personnel matter or any other specialized category.
